clips.title: The story
paras: At the Venture Company digsite in the Barrens, Tinkerer Sniggles holds the Console Key. It unlocks the main control terminal and lets the samophlange be removed once the apparatus is shut down.

The Venture Company runs an industrial outpost in the northern Barrens. Its steam-driven machinery depends on a device called a samophlange. The console is locked against unauthorized hands, and only Tinkerer Sniggles, the chief technician on site, carries the Console Key. The key opens the terminal casing so the rig can be powered down.
